subject: integration
name: Main account (this computer)
summary: The Account the wallet makes at a profile's first start: a recovery phrase of twelve words kept in the profile folder, sealed by the system keyring, which signs here after the person confirms. Open source. It declares no connection, so no server can sign for the person or learn that they did. The phrase is the person's to back up: losing it loses the account, which is the cost of holding the key. Judged here by its publisher.
